purpose: Independently replicate the V79 exploratory 1:1 Hiku/Jiagu frontier signal without changing the mechanism, then permit a separate untouched formal confirmation only if the replication screen passes all three frozen mean gates.

revealed_or_compromised_seed_blocks: E470-E479 V79 exploratory screen with a post-execution pre-audit blindness breach

mechanism.initializer: frozen FaaSRank native request/DAG player order plus faithful deterministic epsilon-greedy initialization and rolling diversity history
post_initializer_guard: candidate node differs from the current node
candidate paper utility exceeds current utility by EPSILON
candidate frozen FaaSRank exploitation score is nonworse within EPSILON
candidate outcome-blind equal-weight Hiku/Jiagu ordinal-Borda penalty is strictly lower by EPSILON
mechanism.hiku_expert: load-faithful Hiku penalty using only the current pre-placement state
mechanism.jiagu_expert: current-demand Jiagu penalty using only the current pre-placement state

execution_order: Commit this plan before generating any E500-E529 input, tape, reference or run artifact.
Do not modify the V79 scheduler implementation or any frozen environment value.
Generate only E500-E509 screen manifests, capture ten base tapes once, derive ten scale5 tapes once and bind identical per-seed tapes to all ten methods.
Build exactly ten candidate references, then run all ninety baselines and ten candidate runs strictly serially without printing or opening intermediate QC or performance output.
Require 100 attempt-one QC passes, zero quarantine, exact ten-way pairing, one runtime identity and a complete result-free joint technical audit before a simultaneous automatic reveal.

If and only if the replication screen passes all three frozen arithmetic-mean gates, freeze the unchanged candidate and create a new committed formal-confirmation execution receipt before generating E510-E529 inputs.
If the replication screen fails any gate, retain all artifacts, generate no E510-E529 inputs and close the frontier-guard family.

analysis.throughput: Arithmetic mean fixed-window throughput across all ten E500-E509 seeds.
analysis.qpr_finite_only: Arithmetic mean per-run fixed-window throughput/(drained-cohort mean latency*cost) across finite positive-completion runs.
analysis.qpr_zero_completed_as_zero: The same per-run QPR with undefined or zero-completion runs assigned zero over all ten seeds.
analysis.baseline_threshold: Per metric, the largest arithmetic mean among the nine same-seed baselines.
analysis.replication_gate: The frozen candidate must strictly exceed all three baseline thresholds; ties fail.
analysis.paired_uncertainty: Report candidate-minus-each-baseline paired BCa 95% intervals without changing the preregistered arithmetic-mean gate.
analysis.screen_success_action: Authorize preparation, but not success, of the untouched E510-E529 formal confirmation block.
analysis.screen_failure_action: Retain every artifact, do not tune on E500-E509, generate no confirmation inputs and close the frontier-guard family.
analysis.formal_confirmation_primary_gate: On E510-E529, the unchanged candidate must again strictly exceed all three same-seed best-baseline arithmetic means; ties fail.
analysis.formal_confirmation_uncertainty: Report paired BCa 95% intervals and bound any claim if an interval includes zero; intervals do not replace or silently relax the primary mean gate.
